name: Explosive Furniture Trap
description: Wiring keeping the furniture together unravels, causing the spring-loaded pieces of furniture and wire to shoot outward.
disable: DC 34 Thievery check (expert) to identify and harmlessly cut the taut wiring

offensiveAbilities.name: Unsprung Wires
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the pile of broken furniture

Effect The pile of furniture and entangling wires explodes outward. The trap deals 6d10+27 slashing damage (DC 32 basic Reflex save). On a failed save, the target takes a -10-foot penalty to all its Speeds for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).
